title: Why Did OpenAI Shut Down Sora? Its Notice Gave One Reason | Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0, Seedance 2.0 Pricing
description:
Why did OpenAI shut down Sora? This video starts with what OpenAI itself said and three dates, then converts each AI video vendor's official price list into "dollars per second, dollars per 8-second clip," works out the clip cost of a 60-second short, and ends with the two pages to check before you pay.

Prices are the list prices on each vendor's official pricing page on September 28, 2026. The Sora 2 price comes from an August 2026 archive of OpenAI's official pricing page and is the Standard price (the Batch price on the same page is half). The Sora web and app experiences were discontinued on April 26, 2026, and the API was shut down on September 24, 2026. Every price states the resolution it assumes; where audio changes the price, it also states whether audio is included; where a pricing page showed no readable numbers, it says "check the official site." "Keep one in three" is an assumption for the example; swap in your own ratio.

Media reports are labeled with the outlet's name and are not OpenAI's statements; "my reading" is the channel host's personal view. The video does not test any model's picture quality; the only measurement is converting official list prices to per-second prices. It cites none of the costs, revenue or user numbers from the reports.
